messages:
erin: Heads-up — planning SDK v2.1.0 cut to prod tomorrow 09:30 PT. Goal: patch release (backcompat) + header rename (X-Client-Version -> X-Redwood-Client) with 7-day fallback. Need: deploy owner, smoke lead, rollback owner, partner comms. Any blockers?
sam: I can own the deploy + monitor the rollout. Will be on standby during the window. :+1:
maria: I’ll run compatibility checklist and kick off post-cut smoke. Quick question — do we need clients to rotate any keys?
erin: No key rotation. Only header rename — gateway will accept both headers during grace period. We’ll add a transform in gateway config.
josh: Can someone draft a short partner note? We should call out header rename, deprecation timeline, and link to migration snippet. I can send to PMs once drafted.
nora: Rollback plan: flip feature-flag in gateway + kubectl rollback for SDK service if needed. Smoke plan: sign-in, streaming, embeddings sample, API error-rate check. I’ll post commands in thread.
nora: ```
# rollback example
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/sdk-service --to-revision=3
# toggle gateway mapping back
redwoodctl gateway update --name api-gateway --set header.mapping=legacy
```
erin: Canary strategy — 5% for 15m, 25% for 15m, then 100%. If errors > 2% or latency P95 regresses by >200ms at any stage -> rollback. Sam, confirm you can abort at any stage.
sam: Confirmed. I’ll watch error budget and latency. I’ll post canary traffic IDs so SRE can follow.
maria: I’ll run these smoke checks during each canary step and post results: auth flow, streaming token refresh, batch embeddings job with sample corpus.
josh: Draft for partners: short + snippet. Will share in #marketing-distro and copy legal. ETA 2h.
erin: Ops notes: update changelog, add migration snippet to docs, create a short sample in the SDK repo showing header rename (backwards-compat helper). Sam/Maria/Nora — add your runbooks to the deploy checklist before EOD.
nora: Added runbook links to the deploy checklist doc. Also preflight commands I ran locally: ```curl -H 'X-Client-Version: 2.0' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping``` returns 200 with legacy header mapping.
sam: I’ll schedule the deploy job and post the job id here when queued.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window set: 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z -> window owner: sam. Canary buckets configured.
erin: Thanks all. If nobody objects I’ll mark this as ready for cutoff. :white_check_mark:
josh: No objections from me. :shipit:
